verdict.rationale: A public GitHub repository at github.com/crossplane/crossplane is cited (crossplane-gh-1), so the source can be read, and a community commenter calls it open source (crossplane-comm-8). However, the pack never names a license or states one first-party, so the 'open license' half of the story rests on a passing community remark. missing for 10: first-party statement naming the open-source license (e.g. Apache 2.0), documentation of repository and contribution openness, independent corroboration of license terms.
